# motherduck_buckets_for_secret (Data Source)

Lists object-storage buckets accessible through a MotherDuck secret.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "motherduck_buckets_for_secret" "analytics" {
  secret_name = "analytics_s3"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `secret_name` (String) MotherDuck secret name.

### Read-Only

- `rows_json` (String, Sensitive) Raw MotherDuck catalog rows encoded as JSON. Sensitive because catalog rows can include share URLs and account metadata.
